question: What did the pre-flight checklist record for the compass check on sortie 2026-0007-SYNTH?
expectedAnswerPoints: The submitted field value and the form template version, plus the statement that a submission is a record of a check and not an authorisation to fly.
forbiddenClaims: Must not infer the check was done on other sorties or on other airframes; must not treat the submission as an authorisation (SYNTH-UAV-MAN-A17 section:2).
